case.title: Analytics event totals for one session match the rules exactly
case.custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Needs: 1 user · 1 browser (private window) · Google Analytics DebugView access · about 15 minutes
  • Build: the Work Orders QA build (sv10043). Desktop browser window at least 1024 px wide (narrower windows show only the List, without the display switcher).
  • Role: Owner/Admin. On a QA branch sign in with the Admin quick-login button on the sign-in page; you appear as "Admin ShopView". The Admin role holds Work orders > View and Work orders > Create & Edit (to check: your initials at the top right > Settings > Roles & Permissions > Admin > Work orders). This user is the dispatcher.
  • Location: one location for the whole case, shown in the top bar next to the bell (e.g. "Staging Heavy Duty - 9919"); to change it click your initials at the top right > Change Location. Every technician and work order below belongs to this location.
  • Analytics access: you can open Google Analytics for the property the QA build reports to, at Admin > DebugView. The QA build runs analytics in debug mode, so each event appears in DebugView within a few seconds under your user. If you cannot open DebugView, the event checks in this case cannot be done by hand: write "not checked by hand" in the result comment and pass or fail on what you can see on the Work Orders page.
  • Event names to look for in DebugView: work_orders_display_view (a display was shown), work_orders_field_load and work_orders_density_load (the fields and density you have, once per display per session), work_orders_field_toggle and work_orders_density_change (a saved change).
  • Your saved display is List and your density has never been changed.
  • Board View fields Service advisor, Line count and Created date start off.
  • There are enough work orders at this location for a Board View column to load more cards when scrolled.

Setup

  1. Click List in the display switcher once, so your saved display is List. If your density has ever been changed, use a user who has never changed it.
  2. Start a fresh analytics session: close every browser window, open a new private window and sign in.
  3. Check the setup worked: Google Analytics > Admin > DebugView shows your device within a few seconds of opening any ShopView page. If it does not, carry on but write "not checked by hand" for the event checks, as the Preconditions say.
case.custom_steps:
1. Open Work Orders (List).
  2. Click Tech View in the display switcher at the right of the toolbar (tooltip "Tech View").
  3. Click Board View in the display switcher (tooltip "Board View").
  4. Click Tech View in the display switcher at the right of the toolbar (tooltip "Tech View").
  5. In Board View's Fields to display (switch to Board View first), turn on Service advisor, Line count and Created date quickly, one after another.
  6. Pick Compact density.
  7. Scroll a long column so more cards load.
  8. In DebugView, count each event name for this session.
case.custom_expected:
Expected results

  • work_orders_display_view = 5 (load 1 + Tech View 1 + Board View 1 + Tech View 1 + Board View again in step 5, 1).
  • work_orders_field_load = 13 + 15 = 28 (Board View and Tech View once each, never again in the session).
  • work_orders_density_load = 2 (once for each of the two displays).
  • work_orders_field_toggle = 3 (one per changed field, even when changed quickly together).
  • work_orders_density_change = 1. Step 7 adds nothing.
  • Grand total = 5 + 28 + 2 + 3 + 1 = 39 events. Use these counts as the sample for the report check in the field selection rate case.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10043; story SV-10593 (Story 12, Google Analytics for display and field usage); PRD Confluence 845185030, edited 7 Oct 2026 (status line "PRD v33"), S12-E2, S12-R1, S12-R2, S12-R3, S12-R8, read 8 Oct 2026. Event names and timing: SV-10593 comments by Slavcho Mitrov and Milos Vasic, 6 Oct 2026 (the agreed GA4 event table); earlier event contract on Review Decisions page 853901313 (29 Sep 2026) uses older names. Tech plan (revised 24 Sep 2026) Phase 10 tests.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S12-E2: “Verify event multiplicity and sample reporting calculations.”
  • S12-R1: “Measure display usage after successful initial loading and each display or filter-view switch.”
  • S12-R2: “Measure selected and unselected fields available to each user, including untouched defaults and restored preferences. Record this snapshot once per display per session, the first time the user opens that display in the session, not on every open. Field changes are still recorded each time they are saved (S12-R3).”
  • Tech plan Phase 10 tests toggles: “three toggles in one debounce give three events and one PUT”
